schema.description: A fiscal Receipt issued for a Payment.

externalId.description: The identifier assigned to the Receipt by the upstream fiscal provider.

date.description: The UTC timestamp when the Receipt was issued.

type.description:
The fiscal type of the Receipt:
- `Sale`: receipt issued for a successful Payment.
- `Void`: receipt issued for a void or refund operation.
type.title: Receipts.ReceiptType

amount.description: The total amount of the Receipt, in cents.

parentReceiptId.description: The ID of the parent Receipt, when this Receipt is a void/refund of a previously issued Sale Receipt.

schema.title: Receipt
